test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question: Seven people A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of C. Only three people sit between C and A. Only one person sits between A and T. U sits to the immediate left of B. V is not an immediate neighbour of A. How many people sit to the right of W?
solution: Given: Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north. 1) Only two people sit to the left of C. 2) Only three people sit between C and A. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/021f505c0ae2fcdb8d05f0f0e1596790333a266e4385d0b28657be87e211d0f7.png]
